title: Adaptively Sparse Transformers
answer_rationale: The retrieved document states that the adaptively sparse Transformer improves interpretability and head diversity compared to softmax Transformers. This is supported by quantitative and qualitative analysis showing that attention heads learn different sparsity preferences and are more diverse in their attention distributions, which aids in uncovering head specializations without sacrificing accuracy.
